verdict.rationale: Mangopay publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.mangopay.com/openapi.json, invites developers to start calling the Sandbox API to explore its features, and offers language-specific getting-started material and test payment methods. Together these support exploring the API with executable calls. However, nothing in the pack shows that the API reference itself is interactive or has in-page runnable examples. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an interactive API reference / in-browser 'try it' console, runnable code samples embedded in reference pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.
